newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates thinly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates thinly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- Five barges, this week, Mississippi River (St Paul-Savage), bid 175 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio River, no bid, offered 165 percent.
- Four barges, one each week of October, Mid-Mississippi, bid 200 percent down 7-1/2 percentage points, no offer.
- Eight barges, two each week of October, Illinois River, no bid, offered 200 percent.
